title: 第1章 开局成野神百倍供品第2章 晋升神位从九品土地正神
slug: 全民成野神唯有我百倍供品
content_zh:
一身白羽的飞鸟振翅，穿过云层。
白云苍狗，群山不断掠过。
飞鸟锐利的眼眸俯视着大地，猛然俯冲而下。
轻盈的从溪流中啄起一条小鱼再次飞起，随即穿过一株株茂密大树、盛开的各色鲜花、忙忙碌碌的蜂群，眼前出现了一座简陋村庄。
它落在村庄北边，一株看起来很有些年头的老柳树上面。
一边梳理着羽毛，一边看着下方跪倒在破旧土地庙前的大量村民。
“李家村所有村民敬上，请彰越公保佑来年风调雨顺！”
村长‘李德阳’拜下，虔诚道。
“李家村所有村民敬上，请彰越公保佑村中儿郎不受妖魔邪祟侵害！”
跪在村长后面的十几名老人颤颤巍巍叩拜，声音一样极为虔诚。
“李家村所有村民敬上，请彰越公保佑村中万事顺意！”
老人后方的壮年男子、妇女、儿童跟着拜下，异口同声道。
“上香！”
村长大喝。
所有人都点燃了手中三柱清香。
“再拜彰越公！”
村长举着三柱清香拜下。
所有人跟着拜下。
渺渺青烟飞起，将前方的土地庙渲染得云蒸雾绕。
就仿佛有一位神只高坐九重霄，正在享用村民香火！

“请彰越公享用供品！”
“三拜彰越公！”
村长第三次拜下。
“请彰越公享用供品！”
“三拜彰越公！”
所有村民跟着第三次拜下。
……
李越有些发懵。
他看着眼前跪倒一片、衣着简陋的村民。
他又看了看自己半透明的身躯。
而且他还发现——
自己身在土地神像中，一座只有方圆一丈的逼仄空间内。
这座土地神像好似化作了囚笼，让他无法离开。
“我穿越了？”
“还穿到了土地神像上？”
这是什么鬼？”
content_en:
A bird with white feathers flutters its wings and flies through the clouds.
The white clouds are like a dog, and the mountains keep passing by.
The bird's sharp eyes looked down at the earth and suddenly swooped down.
He lightly picked up a small fish from the stream and flew up again. Then he passed through dense trees, blooming flowers of various colors, and busy swarms of bees, and a simple village appeared in front of him.
It fell on the north side of the village, on top of an old willow tree that looked very old.
While combing his feathers, he looked down at the large number of villagers kneeling in front of the dilapidated earth temple.
"All the villagers of Lijia Village sincerely wish you good luck in the coming year!"
The village chief ‘Li Deyang’ bowed down and said piously.
"All the villagers of Lijia Village respectfully ask Zhang Yue Gong to protect the sons and gentlemen in the village from evil spirits and evil spirits!"
A dozen old people kneeling behind the village chief bowed tremblingly, their voices equally pious.
"All the villagers of Lijia Village sincerely wish you all the best in the village!"
The middle-aged men, women, and children behind the old man bowed down and said in unison.
"Incense!"
The village chief drank.
Everyone lit three pillars of incense in their hands.
"Better pay homage to Duke Zhang Yue again!"
The village chief held up three pillars of incense and bowed down.
Everyone bowed down.
A mist of green smoke flew up, rendering the Earth Temple in front of it into a cloud of mist.
It's as if there is a god sitting high in the sky, enjoying the incense of the villagers!
"Please enjoy the offerings, Duke Zhangyue!"
"Three thanks to Duke Zhang Yue!"
The village chief bowed for the third time.
"Please enjoy the offerings, Duke Zhangyue!"
"Three thanks to Duke Zhang Yue!"
All the villagers followed and bowed for the third time.
…
Li Yue was a little confused.
He looked at the poorly dressed villagers who were kneeling in front of him.
He looked at his translucent body again.
And he also discovered——
He is in the statue of the earth god, in a cramped space with a radius of only one foot.
This statue of the earth god seemed to have turned into a prison, making it impossible for him to leave.
"I traveled through time?"
"And it was worn on the statue of the earth god?"
What the hell is this? "
